remarks: Welcome to this fully renovated end-unit tri-level townhouse ideally located in Glenbrook on the Darien border, just minutes to shops, restaurants, and multiple train stations.  The sun-filled main level features an open floor plan with a spacious living room, dedicated dining area, and a brand-new modern kitchen with new appliances, sleek finishes, and excellent flow for everyday living and entertaining. Large windows throughout the home bring in abundant natural light.  The upper level offers three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a generous primary bedroom, along with an updated full bath. The layout provides privacy while maintaining a bright, open feel.  The finished lower level adds valuable living space, perfect for a playroom, recreation room, or home office, and includes a walk-in laundry room for added convenience. An oversized garage provides excellent storage in addition to parking.  Completely updated with modern finishes, and thoughtful improvements throughout. This move-in-ready home offers comfort, style, and a prime commuter-friendly location.
